policy.compatibility_rule: Legacy data may be read only by an explicit migration adapter and may never affect a new decision after canonical state exists.
policy.deletion_rule: A legacy path is deleted after its replacement has focused, counterexample, negative-path and complete regression evidence.
policy.fallback_rule: Silent fallback to a retired semantic, capability, plan or transaction owner is forbidden.

retirement_targets.target: keyword, intent-map or tool-first semantic routing
retirement_targets.discovery: inventory every runtime entrypoint and graph edge that can select intent/capability before the semantic contract
retirement_targets.deletion_condition: all request paths use typed SemanticDecision and unsupported/clarify counterexamples pass
retirement_targets.rollback: revert the work-package commit; do not reactivate the retired router as fallback

retirement_targets.target: per-intent pronoun, focus or history resolution
retirement_targets.discovery: inventory slot resolvers and tool adapters that infer targets from untyped history
retirement_targets.deletion_condition: set, subset, correction, interruption and stale-reference counterexamples pass
retirement_targets.rollback: revert canonical resolver changes while preserving fail-closed clarification

retirement_targets.target: grounded_execution_plan and tool-loop scratch plans used as executable authority
retirement_targets.discovery: inventory every field or node that can trigger execution independently of PlanRun
retirement_targets.deletion_condition: multi-goal, clarification and history-recall tests read only immutable PlanRun authority
retirement_targets.rollback: revert the migration; never restore dual executable-plan ownership

retirement_targets.target: checkpoint/model/UI state treated as current business fact
retirement_targets.replacement: BusinessService receipt and versioned query result
retirement_targets.discovery: inventory decisions that trust cached order/refund/ticket state without authoritative read or receipt
retirement_targets.deletion_condition: stale version, replay, unauthorized actor, invalid transition and reconciliation tests pass
retirement_targets.rollback: return FAILED_RETRYABLE or SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN rather than trusting cached state

retirement_targets.target: HTTP, SSE or frontend logic creating independent answer semantics
retirement_targets.replacement: RuntimeOutcome followed by pure ResponseProjector adapters
retirement_targets.discovery: inventory response normalization, stream update and UI card branches that synthesize facts
retirement_targets.deletion_condition: HTTP/SSE equivalence and presentation-registry tests pass from one RuntimeOutcome
retirement_targets.rollback: disable the affected projection path; do not duplicate outcome logic

work_packages.name: Runtime entrypoint inventory
exit_conditions: all graph builders and execution gateways mapped

work_packages.name: PlanRun convergence
exit_conditions: legacy plan fields read-only or deleted

work_packages.name: RuntimeOutcome projection
exit_conditions: frontend creates no new business fact
